foundation.title: Live foundation
foundation.description: Real authentication, MFA and tenant-scoped company/project records. This is separate from the mock business dashboards.
foundation.development: Local development only: verification, reset and invitation messages go to Mailpit on localhost:8025. Phone messages use a development mailbox. Use synthetic identities; no external SMS or real payments are sent.
foundation.limitations: Foundation review, not production approval. External SMS, WhatsApp and email providers, mobile device binding and action-bound financial approvals are not implemented; phone messages go to the development mailbox. Payroll, payment providers, biometric capture and offline business sync remain later-phase work.

registrationV1.title: Your personal information at {company}
registrationV1.intro: Please read this, or ask us to read it to you, before you are registered. It explains what we record about you and why.
registrationV1.who: {company} keeps your work records in a system called PM-Buddy. {company} decides how your information is used (it is the data controller).
registrationV1.what: Your name, date of birth, gender and home county; your ID or passport number; your M-Pesa phone number; your KRA PIN and NSSF and SHA numbers if you have them; a next-of-kin contact; your trade, skill level and NCA card; the projects and gangs you work in; and your pay rate.
registrationV1.why: To confirm who you are and that you are 18 or older; to stop anyone being paid in your name; to pay you correctly; to meet tax, social security and health insurance duties; to check NCA accreditation; and to contact someone if you are hurt at work.
registrationV1.protect: Your ID, phone, KRA PIN and statutory numbers are locked (encrypted). Most staff see only the last digits. A manager who needs a full number must confirm who they are again, and each time is recorded.
registrationV1.share: Only {company} staff who need it for your work. We give KRA, NSSF and SHA what the law requires, and M-Pesa what it needs to pay you. We do not sell your information.
registrationV1.keep: While you work with us, and afterwards only as long as the law requires. Then we delete it.
registrationV1.rights: You can ask to see your information, to correct it, or to have it deleted where the law allows. You can complain to the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC).
registrationV1.withdraw: You can withdraw your agreement at any time by telling your supervisor or the site agent. Records the law requires us to keep are kept.
registrationV1.biometrics: This notice does not cover fingerprints or face recognition. Those need a separate agreement, and you can always use a worker card instead.
registrationV1.question: Do you agree that {company} records and uses this information as described?

payout.title: Payout details
payout.description: M-Pesa and bank details for paying this supplier. Changed details are never usable until a different person verifies them.
payout.notUsable: Not usable for payment until verified
payout.warning: A contact mobile number of this supplier changed recently. Verify by calling a number you already knew before that change.
payout.proposeDescription: Your proposal replaces the current details at once and stays unusable until someone else verifies it.
payout.verifyDescription: Confirm the details independently, for example by calling the supplier on a number you already had.
payout.makerChecker: You made or contributed to these details, so someone else must verify them.

common.reasonHint: At least 3 characters. It is kept with the record.
common.contributors: Prepared or edited by {names}. None of them may approve it (maker-checker).
common.youContributed: You prepared or edited this record, so a different person with approval rights must decide on it.
common.count: {count, plural, =0 {No records} one {# record} other {# records}}
common.attachHint: PDF or photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP), at most 10 MB.

locationError.unsupported: This browser cannot give a position

submit.title: Submit {number}
submit.description: It goes to someone with approval rights. Edits after this need a return to draft.

approve.title: Approve {number}
approve.description: You confirm the content as shown. You cannot approve what you prepared or edited.

reject.title: Reject {number}
reject.description: The requester can return it to draft, correct it and submit it again.

reopen.title: Return {number} to draft
reopen.description: The decision is cleared and the record can be edited and submitted again.

return.title: Return {number} to draft
return.description: The LPO goes back to its preparer with your reason.

cancel.title: Cancel {number}
cancel.description: A cancelled record is kept for the history and cannot change again.

home.title: Procurement
home.description: Requisition → RFQ and quotes → LPO → delivery → supplier invoice with eTIMS → three-way match → payment.
home.inboxDescription: Only what you may act on now: you hold the permission and did not prepare the record.

kinds.invoice-exception: Blocked invoice: an exception may be decided
kinds.invoice-reapproval: Re-approve: the supplier's payout details changed

home.commitmentsDescription: Committed: approved LPOs. Accrued: approved invoices. Both net of VAT. Paid: recorded settlements, including VAT.
home.noCommitments: No procurement on projects you can see yet.

requisitions.title: Requisitions
requisitions.description: Materials requested for a project and site, approved by someone other than the requester.

form.description: Quantities can be in any unit that converts to the material's base unit; impossible conversions are refused, never guessed.
form.noProjects: You cannot raise requisitions on any project.

bqSearch.title: Link a BQ item
bqSearch.description: Search the project's BQ in force. The item must be in the newest approved version; the API checks it.
bqSearch.label: Search by description or reference
bqSearch.truncated: Showing the first 200 matches; narrow the search.

rfqs.title: Requests for quotation
rfqs.description: Suppliers quote for approved requisitions; quotes are compared net of VAT per base unit.

form.title: New request for quotation
form.description: Choose approved requisitions of one project and the suppliers to ask. A requisition is on one live RFQ at a time.
form.noRequisitions: No approved requisitions are waiting for an RFQ on this project.

detail.deliveryDays: {days, plural, =0 {Delivery the same day} one {Delivery in # day} other {Delivery in # days}}

matrix.title: Comparison
matrix.description: Net of VAT per base unit of each material; the line amount is the requested quantity at that price. Lowest per line and lowest complete total are marked.
matrix.empty: The comparison appears once quotations are recorded.

award.title: Minimum quotes
award.dialogDescription: Creates a draft LPO from the chosen quotation. Only complete, unexpired quotations can win.

exception.title: Single-source exception
exception.description: With fewer complete quotations than the minimum, an exception with a reason must be approved by someone who did not prepare the RFQ.
exception.notNeeded: Not needed: there are enough quotations.

quotationForm.title: Record a quotation
quotationForm.description: Every line once: a price per unit with its VAT treatment, or no bid. Prices are also added to the price history.
quotationForm.allQuoted: Every supplier asked has a quotation. Withdraw one to record it again.
quotationForm.uploadFailed: The quotation was recorded but its file was not attached: {message}

lpos.title: Local purchase orders
lpos.description: Approved LPOs are commitments: they never change, and an amendment is a cancellation and a reissue.

detail.supplierTitle: Supplier (as when the LPO was issued)
detail.creditDays: {days, plural, one {# day credit} other {# days credit}}
detail.reissueHint: This LPO was cancelled. Award the RFQ again to issue a replacement.

print.title: Local purchase order {number}
print.notApproved: Not approved: this is not a valid order.
print.footer: Quote the LPO number on the delivery note and the invoice. Invoices need a KRA eTIMS number.

grns.title: Deliveries
grns.description: Goods Received Notes: what was counted on site, with photos, position and the vehicle.

capture.title: Record a delivery
capture.description: Count what arrived, reject what is unacceptable, photograph the delivery note and the goods.
capture.noLpos: No approved LPOs to receive against.
capture.overDelivery: More than the LPO still expects. It will be recorded and flagged for review, not refused.
capture.vehicleHint: Kenyan format, for example KDA 123A. Other plates are kept and flagged.
capture.vehicleOther: Not a Kenyan format: {value} will be flagged
capture.lowAccuracy: Low accuracy: the geofence check may be unreliable.
capture.locationNote: The position is a claim from this device. It is compared with the site geofence after saving; being outside is flagged, never refused.
capture.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB each.
capture.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No photo} one {# photo} other {# photos}} chosen
capture.nothing: Enter a counted quantity for at least one material.
capture.rejectionNeeded: Give a reason for every rejected quantity.
capture.rejectedAbove: Rejected cannot be more than counted.
capture.replayed: {number} was already recorded: this repeat was not counted twice.
capture.evidencePending: Photos still uploading or missing: the delivery is recorded but its evidence is incomplete.
capture.photosFailed: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} could not be uploaded: {message}

detail.evidenceIncomplete: Evidence incomplete: a delivery-note photo and a goods photo are needed
detail.voidDescription: A voided GRN no longer counts as received. Not possible while an approved invoice relies on it.

invoices.title: Supplier invoices
invoices.description: Recorded against an approved LPO with the KRA eTIMS number, then matched with the LPO and the deliveries.

form.description: Type what the supplier's invoice says. PM-Buddy recomputes the amounts and checks them in the three-way match.
form.noLpos: No approved LPOs to invoice against.
form.etimsHint: As printed on the invoice, for example KRACU0400000078/2231.
form.etimsUnrecognised: Unrecognised format: kept, shown as a warning.
form.etimsInvalid: This cannot be an eTIMS number.
form.etimsMissing: No eTIMS number: the invoice is flagged and, while the company setting is on, payment is blocked.
form.totalCheck: The total must equal the subtotal plus VAT.

match.title: Three-way match
match.description: The LPO (ordered, at what price) against the deliveries (accepted on site) and this invoice, per LPO line, in the material's base unit and net of VAT.
match.notRun: The match runs when the invoice is submitted.
match.excepted: Mismatch accepted by an approved exception: payment can be approved.
match.blocked: Blocked: payment cannot be approved until the mismatch is resolved.
match.stale: Out of date: {reasons}. Run the match again before anyone decides.
match.computed: Run by {name} on {date} with {grns, plural, =0 {no deliveries} one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}}.
match.etimsWarns: a missing number is only a warning

totals.order: LPO subtotal {order}; billed before {previous}; allowed in total {allowed}.

checks.subtotal-mismatch: Stated subtotal agrees with the lines
checks.vat-mismatch: Stated VAT agrees with the lines
checks.total-exceeds-order: Within what the LPO allows in total

reasons.not-received: Nothing has been received on this line yet.
reasons.qty-exceeds-received: More is billed (with earlier invoices) than was accepted on site.
reasons.qty-exceeds-ordered: More is billed (with earlier invoices) than was ordered.
reasons.price-above-order: The price is above the LPO price beyond the tolerance.
reasons.line-not-on-order: A billed line is not on the LPO.
reasons.total-arithmetic: The stated total is not the stated subtotal plus VAT.
reasons.subtotal-mismatch: The stated subtotal differs from the recomputed lines.
reasons.vat-mismatch: The stated VAT differs from VAT recomputed on the lines.
reasons.total-exceeds-order: With earlier invoices, more is billed than the LPO allows.
reasons.etims-missing: No KRA eTIMS number: payment is blocked by the company setting.

warnings.etims-missing: No KRA eTIMS number (the company setting allows payment).
warnings.etims-format-unrecognised: The eTIMS number has an unrecognised format.
warnings.price-below-order: A price is below the LPO price.

staleReasons.invoices-changed: another invoice on this LPO was approved
staleReasons.settings-changed: the tolerances or the eTIMS setting changed

exception.title: Exception
exception.dialogDescription: You accept this mismatch with a reason so the invoice can be approved. Use it only when the evidence is outside PM-Buddy.
exception.notExceptable: This mismatch cannot be overridden (missing eTIMS, inconsistent totals or a line not on the LPO). Correct the invoice instead.
exception.contributor: You recorded or edited this invoice, so someone else must decide on an exception.

approval.title: Approval for payment
approval.blocked: Approval is blocked while the three-way match does not pass.
approval.staleBlocked: Approval is blocked until the match is run again.
approval.payee: Pays to the verified payout details (version {version}):
approval.noPayee: The supplier has no verified payout details. Someone must verify them on the supplier page first.
approval.dialogDescription: Your approval binds this match, the invoice as it stands and the payee shown. Any change needs a new approval.
approval.approvedBy: Approved by {name} on {date}: {amount} to payout version {version}.
approval.reapprovalNeeded: Re-approval needed: the supplier's payout details changed after approval. Nothing can be paid until someone approves the new payee.
approval.contributor: You recorded or edited this invoice, so a different person must approve it.
approval.noPermission: Approval needs the payments approval permission.

settlement.title: Payments
settlement.description: Record a payment made outside PM-Buddy (bank, cheque or M-Pesa). It must be recorded by someone other than the approver, and never above what is outstanding.
settlement.referenceHint: The bank, cheque or M-Pesa reference. Each reference is recorded once.
settlement.aboveOutstanding: The amount is more than the outstanding {amount}.
settlement.approverCannot: You approved this invoice, so someone else must record its payment.
settlement.payeeChanged: The payee changed after approval: it must be re-approved before a payment is recorded.
settlement.noPermission: Recording payments needs the payments disbursement permission.
settlement.notApproved: Payments are recorded once the invoice is approved.

invoiceDetail.submitDescription: The three-way match runs at once: the invoice becomes matched, or blocked with the reasons shown.
invoiceDetail.reopenDescription: A corrected version is matched again; the current match no longer counts.
invoiceDetail.cancelDescription: For example after a credit note. Approved invoices cannot be cancelled.
invoiceDetail.uploadFailed: The invoice was saved but its file was not attached. Attach it again below.

settings.title: Procurement settings
settings.description: Apply to the whole company from the next match or award. Earlier matches keep the settings they were run with and show as out of date.
settings.minQuotes: Minimum complete quotations before an award
settings.toleranceHint: 0 to 100, up to four decimals. 0 means exact.
settings.blockEtims: Block payment of invoices without a KRA eTIMS number
settings.blockEtimsHint: Subject to compliance review (CR-TAX-02). When off, a missing number is a warning.
settings.readOnly: Only someone with configuration rights can change these settings.
settings.invalid: Check the values: tolerances are 0–100 % and the minimum is 1–10 quotations.

upload.unsupportedFile: Only PDF files or photos (JPEG, PNG or WebP) are accepted; GRN photos must be images.
upload.fileTooLarge: The file is too large: at most 10 MB (photos 5 MB).
